title: Gluing smallness of perfect isomorphism classes
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme in universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme], $U$ a quasi-compact open, and $V$ an affine open. If $P_w(X,U)$, $P_w(X,V)$ and $P_w(X,U\cap V)$ hold [def-pc-perfect-classes-small-on-open], then $P_w(X,U\cup V)$ holds. Thus smallness of perfect derived isomorphism classes [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-category] glues across this two-open union; no smallness of either full object type is assumed.

source.place: Lemma cohomology-lemma-exact-sequence-j-star, Tag 08BV; cocone encoding in Step 2 of lem-pc-perfect-complexes-compact-set, with the two-open hypothesis of coherent-lemma-induction-principle (08DR)

proof.text: For any open immersion Y into X with image U union V, pull back U,V to a two-open cover of Y, with images U,V,U intersect V. All three opens and Y are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Restriction of a perfect object preserves its locally strictly perfect models and quasi-coherence. Apply the three smallness hypotheses to these three open immersions. Transport the given structures on localized sites of Y through their equivalences with module sheaves on the open subschemes, and use iterated localization for the further open sites. This supplies the required structures in the same universe w without assuming new localizations there.

Use the derived Mayer-Vietoris triangle and replace its three restrictions by skeleton representatives. Transport the second map along their direct-image isomorphisms. For any fixed triple the maps form a u-small type: use a K-injective resolution to compute derived maps as a quotient of the u-small type of chain maps on the u-small open site. The chosen localization comparison is fully faithful, so this smallness is independent of its morphism universe. The triples and maps together are u-small. Cocones of a fixed map are isomorphic by the morphism-of-triangles axiom and two-out-of-three for isomorphisms. The subtype of maps admitting perfect quasi-coherent cocones surjects onto the skeleton of perfect objects. Apply small_of_surjective. For empty opens only the zero isomorphism class occurs. Mathlib CochainComplex.IsKInjective.Qh_map_bijective supplies the comparison. Each admissible map determines its cocone skeleton class uniquely, so no arbitrary object is chosen from an unproved existence statement.
